answer: Each challenge commits to a domain-separated hash of the agent identity, task nonce, and a future drand quicknet pulse; that threshold-BLS-signed beacon value is unpredictable and effectively unbiasable until its round completes. Consequently, a sybil swarm cannot precompute valid responses, farm identities offline, or select favorable assignments: pearl, saffron, and nadir instances remain bound to later randomness, while verification rejects stale, replayed, or malformed proofs.
